stem.text: Compound J, $\text{C}_{15}\text{H}_{23}\text{Br}_2\text{Cl}$, is reacted with an excess of a hot concentrated solution of sodium hydroxide in ethanol. One of the products is **X**.

stem.alt: Reaction scheme: skeletal formula of compound J (bromo, chloro and gem-dimethyl substituted spiro ring with an exocyclic methylene) labelled compound J, then an arrow labelled excess NaOH in ethanol, then product X.

stem.text: What could be the skeletal formula of **X**?

A.alt: Skeletal formula of a spiro compound with two ring C=C bonds, an exocyclic methylene and two methyl groups (option A)

B.alt: Skeletal formula of a spiro compound with a gem-dimethyl group, a ring C=C bond, an exocyclic methylene and a methyl group on the other ring (option B)

C.alt: Skeletal formula of a spiro compound with a ring C=C bond, an exocyclic methylene and two methyl groups (option C)

D.alt: Skeletal formula of a spiro compound with a gem-dimethyl group, a ring C=C bond, an exocyclic methylene and a methyl group on the other ring (option D)
